title: Complaints about Misleading and Derogatory Internet Advertisements
what_it_is: Complaints about Misleading and Derogatory Internet Advertisements

sections.label: Advertising Standards Authority complaints and guidelines
sections.summary: ASAS administers the advertising code, received 124 misleading and five derogatory online ad complaints from 2013 to 2015, and issued social media guidelines.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: The Advertising Standards Authority of Singapore (ASAS) administers the Singapore Code of Advertising Practice (SCAP), which helps to ensure that advertisements are legal, decent, honest and truthful.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: From 2013 to 2015, ASAS received a total of 124 complaints against misleading online advertisements and five complaints against derogatory online advertisements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: ASAS investigated these complaints, which included examples, such as unsubstantiated product claims and racially discriminatory advertisements, and took action against breaches of the SCAP, including contacting the company or website responsible to amend or remove the problematic advertisements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: In cases of egregious or repeated breaches, ASAS may also impose sanctions, such as requiring local media owners that are members of ASAS to withhold advertising space from errant advertisers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: In response to the growing use of online marketing, ASAS issued the Guidelines for Interactive Marketing Communication and Social Media in August this year to clarify its expectations of how advertisers and the parties they work with should design and manage their digital and social media marketing communications, so as to enable consumers to make informed choices about the products and services advertised online.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: The Government supports the advertising industry's efforts to strengthen self-regulation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: However, the Government will also not hesitate to act against online advertisements that contain egregious content such as those that threaten racial or religious harmony, public morality or are against national or public interest.

sections.label: Yearly complaint numbers
sections.summary: Complaints totalled 39 in 2013, 37 in 2014 and 48 in 2015.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The total number of complaints in 2013 was 39, followed by 2014 with 37, and 2015 with 48.

sections.label: Racial sensitivities and enforcement
sections.summary: Some cases involve racial sensitivities or egregious comments, so engagement, education and enforcement are combined.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Some are because of issues of racial sensitivities or egregious comments that were made.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, it is a combination of engagement, education and enforcement.
